causal_claim.content: CVD growth causes less lattice damage than ion implantation, improving coherence time and charge stability.

mechanism_principle.content: In these samples, strain can be isolated as the main dephasing source beyond spin noise because electric-field noise is small under stable conditions and low NV concentration.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: Strain can then be assumed to be the main dephas- ing source other from the spin noise in a temperature- stable and magnetically homogeneous environment since Γelec is reported only to contribute less than 10% of the sum Γstrain + Γelec [31]. Furthermore, the electric-field- induced decay factor with respect to [NV] is predicted to be only 11.2 kHz/ppm2/3 [31], which is small in our samples where [NV] is always less than 1 ppm

mechanism_principle.content: S2's strong nitrogen overshoot makes [P1] differ substantially near versus far from the interface, causing layer-to-layer heterogeneity.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: This is not surprising because S2 exhibits a significant nitrogen overshoot, and the [P1] near and far from the interface differ substantially, causing layer-to- layer heterogeneity.

mechanism_principle.content: Sudden nitrogen injection perturbs gas flow, deviating growth from optimum.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: One possible reason for the for- mation of these defects is that the sudden injection of nitrogen gas perturbs the overall gas flow and causes the growth conditions to deviate from the optimum.

mechanism_principle.content: The sensitivity estimate assumes optimal operation when sensing time equals decay time.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: Assuming operation under optimal conditions, with Tsens = Tdecay

mechanism_principle.content: The DEER on-axis decay samples only one-twelfth of the full P1 bath because the applied pulse addresses one transition of on-axis P1 centers.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: This frequency is resonant with one transition of the on-axis P1 centers, so the measured decay rate ΓDEER, on-axis represents only 1/12 of the total P1 spin bath

mechanism_principle.content: The measured on-axis DEER decay samples only a twelfth of the total P1 bath because of hyperfine lines and orientation multiplicity.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span: Because there are three nitrogen hyperfine lines and four P1-center axes, including one on-axis and three off-axis orientations, the measured DEER decay ΓP1, on-axis represents only 1/12 of the coupling to the full P1 spin bath.

mechanism_principle.content: Effective depths not being centered in the layer may arise because measurement time changes weighting toward deeper NVs with better coherence at longer times.
mechanism_principle.evidence_span:
This can be possibly explained by the dependence of the effective depth on the measurement time, because the coherence properties of individual NV centers depend strongly on their depth.
Thus, for a longer measurement time, the effective depth is weighted more strongly toward deeper NV centers.
